This spacious family home is a beautiful colonial style house located only 15 minutes from the hustle & bustle of downtown Nashville. Enjoy great outdoor areas where you can relax & soak up the sun & beautiful views by the lovely pool and warm up in the winter months in the hot tub! Explore everything this amazing house has to offer
